Based on the visual evidence of the app thumbnail card located to the left of the QR code:

(1) **Yes**, the thumbnail features a **navy blue gradient background** that transitions from a lighter blue-grey at the top-left to a deeper navy blue at the bottom-right.
(2) **Yes**, there is a distinct **orange squircle (rounded square) app icon** on the left side containing the white "C" logo.
(3) **Yes**, the text **"Concordia College" is rendered in white**, with a smaller, lighter grey subtitle ("Management Portal") beneath it.
(4) **Yes**, there is a **viewfinder/scan icon** (resembling a camera focus frame) positioned on the right side of the card.
(5) **Partially/No.** While the card has rounded corners and a subtle drop shadow giving it depth, it does not exhibit strong **glassmorphism** (like heavy background blur or translucent frosted glass effects). It looks more like a solid, sleek material design card with a matte or satin finish rather than a "frosted" look.
(6) **Yes, overall it matches a professional app-store thumbnail style.** It follows modern UI conventions by using brand-consistent colors (navy and orange), clear typography hierarchy, and a clean layout that effectively communicates the app's identity at a glance. It looks polished and suitable for promotional use.
